result.summary: Implemented per design: TC-SPT-01-06 now generates a fresh UUID via randomUuidStr(), inserts a public.tenant row (storage_mode='SCHEMA') before acquiring the pool connection, and cleans it up via an unconditional defer. zig build exits 0, no 'error set' output. Verified via isolated zig build test-integration-svc run: TC-SPT-01-06 passes; failing-test-set diff before/after shows TC-SPT-01-06 as the only delta (74 pre-existing unrelated failures unchanged).

issues.description: Initial attempt set tenant_type='test' on the inserted row to align with clean_test_db.py's cleanup filter, but this tripped ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence (test-type tenants require a non-null production_tenant_id). Reverted to omitting tenant_type (defaults to 'production'); the row's unconditional defer cleanup does not depend on clean_test_db.py's type filter, so this is safe. Filed the broader tenant_type-leak pattern as ISS-0100 / GitHub #357 since it affects many other pre-existing tests.
